name: Terabase Energy Terafab
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: pre-assembling PV modules onto tracker torque tubes and delivering them to the rows
summary: An automated field factory set up on a utility-scale solar site: robots mount PV modules onto tracker torque tubes with in-line quality checks, and rovers carry the assemblies to the rows, where workers place them on the trackers.

germany.statusNote: Deployed only on US projects; the current version is built for First Solar Series 7 modules and Nextpower trackers. Terabase's 2026 move into Europe (Paris R&D office) covers its Construct software, not Terafab. No European offer, partner or project found.

notes: A relocatable assembly line set up on the solar site, not a mobile robot; industrial robot arms unpack and handle modules and torque tubes (number of arms not stated; set to 2 as the trade press speaks of arms in the plural).
Purpose-built rovers carry the finished assemblies to the rows; their drive type is not stated, so wheels and tracks are left false.
In the current version workers unload the assemblies from the rovers and fit them onto pre-placed tracker mounts; the maker plans to automate this step in 2027.
Built for outdoor work in heat, dust, wind, rain and mud.
Availability (April 2026): two deployable factories, a third expected by the end of 2026, ten in Q2 2027 (CEO in trade press).

evidence.task: Field test: built 10 MW of a 400 MW solar site
First commercial project: installed 17 MW of the 225 MW White Wing Ranch solar plant; no manual lifting of steel tubes or panels; 25% higher labour productivity than manual installation
evidence.where: White Wing Ranch, Arizona, USA (developer Leeward Renewable Energy, EPC RES)

evidence.task: First-generation system used on five solar power plant projects
evidence.note: The maker's product page gives over 100 MW installed on US projects; a pv magazine interview in April 2026 gives 40 MW for the first version.

evidence.task: Second-generation system completed field testing and was declared ready for commercial shipment
